task: Fix the critical cross-lane contract break that prevents the core apply flow from ever succeeding: (1) change bridge.requestApply to send only { confirmedDiffHash } — remove the ops key — matching the platform postApplyPlan strict schema which rejects any extra key with INVALID_QUERY; (2) add a bridge.confirmDiff(plan) method that POSTs to /confirm-diff with exactly { plan }, matching the platform confirmDiffEndpoint schema; (3) wire the confirm-diff flow in the UI so that after the user confirms a diff preview, the dashboard calls bridge.confirmDiff with a MutationPlan object (planId, scope, ruleVersion, changes, createdAt, createdBy, reason) built from the current draft state, stores the platform-returned confirmedDiffHash in state.confirmedHash, and only then enables the apply button; (4) update tests/ui/bridge.test.js assertion for requestApply to expect { confirmedDiffHash } only (remove ops assertion), and add new tests for bridge.confirmDiff posting { plan } and returning the hash; (5) add a cross-lane parity test that imports both computeScheduleDiff from src/ui/diff and computePlanHash from src/platform and proves agreement; (6) update any applyFlow tests to reflect the corrected payload sequence (confirm-diff first, then apply with hash only).
reason: Cross-lane audit at SHA 810c8b88be41aa2dba5ca2f251182a93cdb81518 (rejected candidate from parent ec916b75d5600e02d679d264648ac92333d721f1) identified three critical cross-lane contract breaks: C1 — the dashboard bridge.requestApply always sends { ops, confirmedDiffHash } but the platform endpoint postApplyPlan (mutationEndpoints.ts:91-98) strictly rejects any key other than confirmedDiffHash with INVALID_QUERY, so the core apply flow can never succeed from the dashboard; C2 — the new POST /confirm-diff endpoint built by the integration candidate is completely unreachable from the dashboard because no bridge.confirmDiff method exists and no UI code calls it, making the confirm-diff durability machinery dead code; C3 — the F3 hash-parity claim between UI (fnv1aHex(stableStringify(ops)) over the diff ops array) and platform (fnv1aHex(canonicalPlanSerialization(plan)) over the full MutationPlan) is false in practice and untested. All three findings are dashboard-owned or require dashboard changes to resolve. C1 and C2 are the immediate blockers: the entire schedule-mutation pipeline is non-functional without fixing the bridge payload and wiring the confirm-diff flow. The integration lane's confirm-diff platform work is sound in isolation but disconnected from the UI. This task addresses C1, C2, and the dashboard side of C3 (parity test), which are the minimum repairs needed to make the integrated preview's core flow functional again.
